chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Husayn narrated from Safwan, from al-'Ala', from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the Imams (peace be upon them both), who said:
I asked him about a man who forgot to perform the tawaf between al-Safa and al-Marwah, so he said: 'Tawaf is performed on his behalf.'

key_terms.يُطَافُ عَنْهُ: tawaf is performed on his behalf

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a pilgrim forgets to perform Sa'i between Safa and Marwah during Hajj?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, the Imam clarifies that forgetting the Sa'i between Safa and Marwah does not invalidate the pilgrimage but merely requires its performance, either personally or by proxy. This ruling underscores the Shia jurisprudential principle that minor omissions due to forgetfulness are rectified through completion rather than penalty, distinguishing them from intentional neglect. The emphasis on 'performing it for him' highlights the flexibility in fulfilling ritual obligations when the pilgrim is unable to do so directly.
